gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cairo: Happy Monkey draws every stroke like a fixed pen. Cairo sits beneath it with wide, easy openings into each round letter, so the loud top line and the smooth text below stay out of each other's way.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cairo-play: Cairo Play has open, round letters that stay readable even when the text gets small and tight. Happy Monkey above it holds every stroke to one measured thickness.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cambay: Cambay reads modern, with rounds that gap like a cracked bangle. Happy Monkey is the one for bold, bent-paperclip display lines with no thick-thin shifts, while Cambay's sans-serif text does the quieter work of carrying the words.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-cantarell: Cantarell feels approachable, its c shapes pulled well apart and its arches in r, n and m matching their stems. And Happy Monkey's ruler-straight strokes above it make the whole text feel friendly rather than stiff, line after line.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-catamaran: Catamaran has curvy letters that feel unclamped, loose and friendly on the page. Catamaran keeps that relaxed motion going down a whole column, while Happy Monkey's curves and straights share one single width up top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Chunky, uniform and unmistakable. Happy Monkey cuts every line to a single engraver's depth, and Chiron Hei HK follows with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, a modern sans that gives the loud heading room.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-commissioner: Happy Monkey brings bold, distinctive display letters with wide gaps in the e. But Commissioner underneath draws every stroke at one thickness with no clogged curves, so a roomy heading size lets the two sit comfortably.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads professional yet approachable, with wide channels leading into each counter and a tube-like thickness through every bend. And Happy Monkey earns its keep big and short, where its ruler-straight bold strokes can stand alone.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-doto: Doto surrounds each glyph with wide margins of space and gives its round letters generous mouths. And Happy Monkey's pen-like line of constant weight is what makes that modern sans feel so approachable beneath it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri reads clean and modern, with a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the c's two ends. El Messiri can take a generous size, while Happy Monkey's strokes stay pressure-free where the eye would otherwise slow down.
